description: Kim is late for his first day at his new WBC drama production, where he was supposed to meet his first model as her manager. It's good that his newly minted colleagues foresaw everything and greeted Hyo Ri well. As soon as Kim Sang finally gets to work, Hyo Ri immediately goes with him to the editing room to discuss some details of future filming. At least that's what everyone thought... It turned out that Hyo Ri and Kim Sang have long forgotten love ties and now they need to be hidden somehow...
